title: Lefse
description: A traditional dish from Norway, centered on potato, all-purpose flour, heavy cream. A measured home-kitchen version organized by cooking step.

steps.instruction: Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 22 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Roll or press the prepared dough evenly into the desired thickness and shape.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 13 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
